messages.author: 25f4eac5601628b9
messages.subject: Monte Carlo Simulation Results in Negative Variances
parts:
Hello,

I am trying to run a Monte Carlo Simulation to determine my power with my n of 71 based on previous models. However, I get a warning that “some estimates of ov variances are negative”. Even with her n I get the same warning. Not sure how I can correct that for generated data.

Please, help. Thank you!

pop.model <- "
f1 =~ 0.94*y1 + 0.87*y2 + 0.74*y3
f2 =~ 0.99*y4 + 0.80*y5 + 0.90*y6

f4 =~ 0.98*y10 + 0.73*y11 + 0.77*y12
f5 =~ 0.97*y13 + 0.87*y14 + 0.89*y15
f6 =~ 1.00*y16 + 0.82*y17 + 0.89*y18
f2 ~~ 0.61*f3
f3 ~~ 0.42*f1
f1 ~~ 0.40*f4
f2 ~~ 0.43*f4
f3 ~~ 0.47*f4
f1 ~~ 0.41*f5
f2 ~~ 0.39*f5
f3 ~~ 0.48*f5
f4 ~~ 0.55*f5
f1 ~~ 0.42*f6
f2 ~~ 0.43*f6
f3 ~~ 0.44*f6
f4 ~~ 0.47*f6
f5 ~~ 0.48*f6
f1 ~~ 0.51*f2
f1 ~~ 1*f1
f2 ~~ 1*f2
f3 ~~ 1*f3
f4 ~~ 1*f4
f5 ~~ 1*f5
f6 ~~ 1*f6
"
analysis.model <- "
f1 =~ y1 + y2 + y3
f2 =~ y4 + y5 + y6
f3 =~ y7 + y8 + y9
f4 =~ y10 + y11 + y12
f5 =~ y13 + y14 + y15
f6 =~ y16 + y17 + y18
f1 ~~ 1*f1
f2 ~~ 1*f2
f3 ~~ 1*f3
f4 ~~ 1*f4
f5 ~~ 1*f5
f6 ~~ 1*f6
"
pop.modelOut<-sim(1000, model=analysis.model, n=71, generate=pop.model, lavaanfun="lavaan",auto.var=TRUE, auto.fix.first=FALSE)
summaryParam(pop.modelOut)

messages.subject: Re: Monte Carlo Simulation Results in Negative Variances
parts: Not sure how I can correct that for generated data.

Correct what?  That can occur just due to sampling error, as your simulation shows.  This is why, for real data, it is recommended to test whether a Heywood case is consistent with mere sampling error.

https://doi.org/10.1177/0049124112442138
